name: Supplier questionnaire
summary: A supplier register with a qualification questionnaire, certificates with expiry dates, a risk tier, an approval decision and a date for the next review.
description: Qualify suppliers and contractors in one place: send a questionnaire, collect certificates and clearances with their valid-until dates, tier each supplier by risk, record the decision (approve, approve with conditions, escalate, reject) and see what expires next. It coordinates evidence. It does not decide legal compliance, screen sanctions or financial risk, or replace your quality system, ERP or document archive.

prompt.intro: Set up a supplier register in my Customermates workspace: suppliers with a risk tier and a qualification status, questionnaires with due dates and a decision, documents with valid-until dates, and dated follow-ups.
questions: How many suppliers do you have, and how do you split them by risk?
Which certificates or clearances do you ask for, and how long is each valid?
Who reviews the answers and who approves a supplier?
How often do you re-evaluate a supplier? Files stay in your document system and only a link is kept here.
